title: A person can see a generated image candidate before applying it
description:
Reported 2026-11-12 by the MoM story session after the first real generation on MoM (5.108.0): round-b6e2351b017c, candidate-edd9d458e88e. `papyrus images show <candidate-id>` answers 'image_candidate_get is described but not built yet' and `images round` gives no preview URL, so nobody can look at a generated picture before applying it. The test candidate was left unapplied for that reason.

Goal: as an editor (person or agent) I can see every candidate of a round before I apply, discard or pick one. Ryan's rules apply: no real likenesses in generated images, and a person approves every piece, so seeing the picture is the minimum.

Build: implement the described-but-unbuilt operation (image_candidate_get) through the one operation table (CLI, MCP, newsroom UI, skill): returns the candidate's metadata (prompt, model, cost, time, round, Story) and a short-lived signed URL to the stored file (candidate files live in S3 as ModelAttachment role image_candidate_file; the picture bytes never go through DynamoDB); `images round` lists each candidate with its preview URL; the newsroom shows the candidates of a round side by side with Apply, Discard and Pick actions (colour never the only signal, plain text, Lucide icons, flat fills, 375px). Related: PPY-43a20d (candidate store for A/B visuals), PPY-6f9fb906 (ImageCandidate).

```gherkin
Feature: See a generated image candidate before applying it
  Scenario: Show a candidate
    Given a round with a ready candidate
    When an editor runs images show for the candidate
    Then it prints the prompt, the model, the cost and a preview URL that serves the picture
  Scenario: A round lists its candidates with previews
    Given a round with three ready candidates
    When an editor runs images round for it
    Then each candidate is listed with its preview URL
  Scenario: The preview link expires
    Given a preview URL older than its lifetime
    Then it no longer serves the picture and asking again gives a fresh one
  Scenario: Candidates side by side in the newsroom
    Given a Story with a round of candidates
    When an editor opens the Story's images
    Then the candidates appear side by side with Apply, Discard and Pick
```
